scheme_name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy for Work Force Welfare Assistance (WWAS)
other_conditions: The enterprise must be a Micro, Small or Medium Enterprise operating in the manufacturing sector.
Production must have started on or after 1 April 2019.
The enterprise may be private, cooperative, joint sector, state‑owned/managed, or an industrial SHG.
Date of Commencement of Commercial Production (DOCCP) must fall between 1 April 2020 and 31 March 2025.
Application must be submitted within 12 months from the DOCCP or from the Banglashree notification, whichever is later.
At least 50% of the employees must be recruited from persons registered with the Employment Bank of the State.
Eligibility category noted in source: Micro
Eligibility category noted in source: Small
Eligibility category noted in source: Medium
benefits_summary: Eligible MSMEs receive reimbursement of 100% of ESI and EPF contributions in the first year and 75% in subsequent years, for a period of 5–9 years depending on the zone.
